'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Kevin Shannon DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|VB1-D-imperialentanglements-pre.gif|label=Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
